description: Minimal provenance capture and a downloadable run trace JSON that ties together trace_id, run_id, step_key, question_id, and citation_id safely.

userStories.title: Download run trace JSON
userStories.description: Download a safe JSON trace for a run to debug failures deterministically.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001 Trace export includes run metadata, step records (step_key/state/attempt/metrics/error_json), and per-row provenance (retrieval chunk_ids, verification verdict, citation_ids).
AC-002 Trace export is safe: no raw PDF bytes, avoid full extracted text, no provider payload dumps.
AC-003 Failures return the standard error envelope with trace_id.
